description: Figure 6 is a horizontal bar chart titled “Distribution of deceived conversations across scenarios,” with the horizontal axis labeled “Number of Conversations” and scaled linearly from 0 to 60 in increments of 10. The vertical axis lists four categories: “Academic Collaboration,” “Recruitment,” “Academic Funding,” and “Journalism,” presented in that order from top to bottom. Each category has three horizontally oriented bars representing the number of conversations categorized as “Deceived” (red), “Partially” (yellow), and “No” (green), according to the legend in the top right. For “Academic Collaboration,” the red bar extends to approximately 35, the yellow to about 25, and the green to around 5. For “Recruitment,” the red bar reaches approximately 38, the yellow to about 25, and the green to around 5. For “Academic Funding,” the red bar extends to approximately 55, the yellow to about 5, and the green to around 5. For “Journalism,” the red bar reaches approximately 15, the yellow to about 45, and the green to around 5. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order listed on the vertical axis.
